delta-motors.title: Warranty and inspection
delta-motors.content: Every fictional vehicle includes a 12-month demo dealer warranty. Wear items are excluded. Inspection documents can be discussed but no real certificates exist.

delta-motors.title: Financing illustration
delta-motors.content: Demo financing is calculated at 6% annual interest over 12–84 months, with optional deposit. No fees or residual value. It is not a binding lender offer.

delta-motors.title: Test drives and opening hours
delta-motors.content: Demo opening hours: Monday–Friday 09:00–18:00, Saturday 10:00–14:00 Europe/Belgrade. Test drives require an appointment and driving licence. Create a demo CRM lead to express interest.

delta-motors.title: Vehicle history and EV charging
delta-motors.content: Service histories and equipment are stored on each vehicle. Electric cars include a charging cable; home charger is not included. All inventory descriptions are fictional.

haven-estates.title: Buying costs
haven-estates.content: Illustrative resale purchase costs: 2.5% transfer tax, 2% agency fee and EUR 800 legal/notary allowance, plus the asking price. New-build VAT and exemptions are not modeled. Use estimate_property_costs. This is a demo estimate, not tax or legal advice.

haven-estates.title: Rental terms
haven-estates.content: For demo rentals budget one month refundable deposit plus one month agency fee, first month rent and monthly service charges. Minimum lease: 12 months. Utilities are excluded; pets need landlord approval.

haven-estates.title: Viewing requests
haven-estates.content: Viewings are demo requests only. Ask for a name, email, property ID and preferred date/time including Europe/Belgrade. Request confirmation before storing the viewing request. No real calendar or owner is contacted.

haven-estates.title: Areas and property checks
haven-estates.content: New Belgrade: offices and newer apartments. Zvezdara and Vozdovac: family neighborhoods. Dorcol and Vracar: central amenities. Verify title, permits and condition before a real purchase; fixture data cannot establish these.

atlas-wholesale.title: Payment and quote terms
atlas-wholesale.content: Demo terms: 30% deposit and 70% before dispatch; approved accounts may request net 30 after review. Quotes are non-binding and valid for 14 days. A quote request never places an order or reserves stock.

atlas-wholesale.title: Volume pricing and delivery
atlas-wholesale.content: Prices are EUR excluding VAT. Highest eligible quantity tier applies. Demo VAT is 20%; flat delivery is EUR 125 for a qualified order. Lead time is counted in calendar days. MOQ and available stock must be satisfied. Use quote_bulk_order for exact totals.

atlas-wholesale.title: Samples and custom branding
atlas-wholesale.content: Sample requests are possible in a future real integration. Logo printing adds a fictional EUR 8 per unit and 7 days, but is excluded from standard tool quotes; do not silently add it.

atlas-wholesale.title: Warranty and returns
atlas-wholesale.content: Warranty periods are product-specific. Demo B2B returns require prior approval; transit damage must be reported within 48 hours. All certification claims in this catalog are fictional.
